findings.frozenDecision: 比亚迪 High-priority sector_confirmed selection over 上汽集团/长城汽车
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: The operating engine did not fail. BYD Q3 revenue still grew 38.49% YoY, attributable profit 82.16% YoY, and YTD attributable profit 129.47%. The stock nevertheless de-rated sharply and underperformed lower-growth frozen peers.
findings.rootCause: The Skill treated extraordinary realized growth plus an early-turn price state as sufficient evidence of expectation room. It under-modeled how much multi-year growth, margin resilience and competitive leadership were already embedded in a 27x/21x 2023E/2024E valuation and broad analyst optimism. Absolute earnings acceleration was real, but incremental surprise versus the market's required duration was not large enough to support the premium.
findings.generalLesson: A strong company and a correct earnings bridge are not sufficient. Expectation burden must ask what duration/intensity of superior growth the current premium already requires versus cheaper controls. A temporary 60d de-rating/early-turn does not prove expectations are low.

findings.frozenDecision: 中国海油 Research selection because sustained 20d/60d strength and a ~30% Q3 oil rerating were treated as high expectation-absorption risk
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: CNOOC remained operationally resilient: Q3 production rose about 7% YoY and unit cost control stayed strong. The low frozen forward valuation and persistent production/cash-generation engine allowed further outperformance despite prior price strength.
findings.rootCause: The Skill correctly recognized price absorption risk but over-weighted the fact that both crude and the stock had already rerated. Sustained strength can remain investable when valuation burden is still low and the earnings/cash-flow duration is long enough.
findings.generalLesson: Already-rerated is not synonymous with fully-priced. Price-path direction must be integrated with valuation burden and the duration of the earnings engine; it should not become a standalone veto on the normal sector-confirmed route.

priorCases.interpretation: Realized engine plus reasonable burden and clear peer edge; broad 60d de-rating had not consumed the company engine.
Longer-window rerating had already occurred and short-window reversal signaled absorption/reversal.

newCases.interpretation: Early-turn is not sufficient by itself; premium valuation can already encode long-duration superior growth even after a recent de-rating.
Sustained strength is not necessarily exhausted when valuation remains low and the earnings engine is durable.

crossWindowExpectationAbsorptionCheck.interpretation: Price-path direction is useful but incomplete. The remaining question is expectation duration/intensity: how much future superior earnings persistence is already required by valuation and consensus versus controls.

prohibitedUses: Do not alter v1.1 using this same 2023Q3 run.
Do not convert early_turn or sustained_strength into universal buy/sell labels.
Do not learn a fixed PE, growth, momentum or return threshold from BYD/CNOOC.
Any future expectation-duration rule requires repetition in another independent holdout before versioning.

nextValidation.proposedAction: Run at least one more independent holdout with v1.1 unchanged, explicitly recording valuation/consensus duration burden in postmortem.
